Card Q&A.q: I activate an effect that reads, “Add 1 card from your security to your hand. Then, .” Even though I lost a card from my security, does the  allow me to activate this card’s inherited effect?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When a card is added to your security stack, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -1000 DP for the turn.
